name: orca-matriarch
description: Development tooling for Matriarch. The repository root is the plugin: Orca installs every tracked file.

scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm validate && pnpm binaries
scripts.preview:build: tsc --ignoreConfig --outDir tools/preview/js --rootDir src --module esnext --target es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --noCheck --skipLibCheck --types '' src/view/main.ts
